c2-act-0033: Lift your eyes to this sermon. Paul begins to speak in the synagogue. Read Acts 13:16.
c2-act-0034: Every journey has a next chapter. Here a new visit is told. Read Acts 14:1 and Acts 13:9.
c3-gal-0010: Rise with Paul’s own story. He recalls another trip to Jerusalem. Read Galatians 2:2 and Galatians 1:18.
c3-rom-0021: Paul’s love reaches wide. He writes of a debt he gladly carries. Read Romans 1:14 and Romans 1:8.
c3-1co-0010: Even small memories matter. Paul corrects his own record here. Read First Corinthians 1:16 and First Corinthians 1:11.
c3-act-0035: Keep seeking what is true. From Miletus, Paul later sends for the elders. Read Acts 17:11 and Acts 20:17.
c3-act-0036: God works in surprising ways. Unusual things happen through Paul’s hands. Read Acts 19:12 and Acts 21:8.
c3-act-0037: Your past can serve God’s purpose. Paul tells where he was raised. Read Acts 22:3 and Acts 23:26.
c3-act-0038: Speak the truth boldly. Paul speaks plainly before Festus. Read Acts 25:10 and Acts 26:32.
c3-act-0039: Keep sailing on. The voyage reaches another port. Read Acts 27:5 and Acts 18:1.
c2-eph-0008: Grace never runs dry. Paul praises what God gives His people. Read Ephesians 1:8.
c2-eph-0009: Lift your heads. Paul celebrates what Christ won for us. Read Ephesians 1:7 and Ephesians 2:4.
c3-eph-0010: There’s purpose in your story. This verse tells why God chose His people. Read Ephesians 1:12 and Ephesians 3:1.
c3-eph-0011: God’s plan was bigger than anyone guessed. Paul reveals a hidden mystery. Read Ephesians 3:6 and Ephesians 2:1.
c3-eph-0012: Prayer lifts us higher. Paul turns to God on their behalf. Read Ephesians 3:14 and Ephesians 4:3.
c3-eph-0013: Hope rises here. Paul explains what Christ has accomplished. Read Ephesians 2:14 and Ephesians 1:14.
c3-eph-0014: Look up and see God’s kindness. Paul opens with a great gift. Read Ephesians 1:5 and Ephesians 3:20.
c3-eph-0015: Every gift has a purpose. Christ equips His church through His gifts. Read Ephesians 4:11 and Ephesians 2:22.
c3-eph-0016: Begin with worship. Paul opens with praise to the Father. Read Ephesians 1:3 and Ephesians 4:2.
c3-eph-0017: Keep reaching. Paul’s prayer for them goes on. Read Ephesians 3:18 and Ephesians 4:4.
c2-php-0016: Encouragement builds strength. Paul tells why he is so sure about them. Read Philippians 1:7.
c2-col-0005: Every letter begins with care. See whom Paul addresses here. Read Colossians 1:2 and Colossians 4:2.
c3-php-0003: Love keeps reaching out. Paul’s prayer for the church continues. Read Philippians 1:10 and Philippians 1:9.
c3-phm-0006: Blessings follow us home. Paul closes his short letter warmly. Read Philemon 1:25 and Philemon 1:23.
c3-act-0040: Hope keeps speaking. Paul explains why he called the leaders together. Read Acts 28:20 and Acts 28:16.
c3-eph-0019: Finish well. Paul begins his farewell blessing. Read Ephesians 6:23 and Ephesians 1:1.
c3-col-0006: Your life speaks. Paul gives counsel for living among others. Read Colossians 4:5 and Colossians 1:12.
c3-php-0004: Joy runs through this letter. Paul greets a church he loves. Read Philippians 1:1 and Philippians 1:5.
c3-act-0041: The story closes with hope. See how Paul spends his days in Rome. Read Acts 28:31 and Acts 28:18.
c3-php-0005: Friendship in Christ is a gift. Paul writes to this dear church. Read Philippians 1:8 and Philippians 1:2.
c2-1ti-0005: Gratitude lifts the soul. Paul looks back on God’s mercy to him. Read First Timothy 1:12.
c2-1ti-0006: Leading God’s people is a serious trust. Paul adds another qualification. Read First Timothy 3:6 and First Timothy 1:4.
c3-1ti-0007: Character matters to God. Paul describes a church leader’s life. Read First Timothy 3:2 and First Timothy 1:8.
c3-2ti-0006: Keep going strong. Paul offers another picture of serving well. Read Second Timothy 2:5 and Second Timothy 2:3.
c3-2ti-0007: Friends matter in hard seasons. Paul writes about his companions. Read Second Timothy 4:11 and Second Timothy 4:13.
c3-1ti-0008: Hold on to sound words. Paul describes those who have strayed. Read First Timothy 1:7 and First Timothy 3:16.
c3-1ti-0009: Every assignment matters. Paul explains why he left Timothy where he was. Read First Timothy 1:3 and First Timothy 6:16.
c3-1ti-0010: Godly leaders are shaped day by day. Paul’s list goes on. Read First Timothy 3:4 and First Timothy 6:20.
c3-2ti-0008: Suffering doesn’t have the last word. Paul shares what keeps him steady. Read Second Timothy 1:12 and Second Timothy 2:11.
c3-2ti-0009: Hope looks up. Paul’s trustworthy saying goes on. Read Second Timothy 2:12 and Second Timothy 4:21.
c2-php-0006: God uses every season, even hard ones. Paul shares good news from prison. Read Philippians 1:13.
c2-php-0007: Good can come from hard places. Paul opens an update for his friends. Read Philippians 1:12 and Philippians 1:17.
c3-php-0008: His humility lifts us up. Paul describes how low Christ came. Read Philippians 2:8 and Philippians 2:6.
c3-php-0009: God’s message moves on. Paul describes those proclaiming Christ. Read Philippians 1:15 and Philippians 3:4.
c3-php-0010: There’s always room to rise. Paul speaks humbly about his own progress. Read Philippians 3:12 and Philippians 1:26.
c3-php-0011: Courage can spread. Paul tells how his situation affected others. Read Philippians 1:14 and Philippians 3:2.
c3-php-0012: It’s okay to be honest. Paul writes openly to his friends. Read Philippians 1:23 and Philippians 2:9.
c3-php-0013: God’s work goes on, whatever people intend. Paul describes another group of preachers. Read Philippians 1:16 and Philippians 3:14.
c3-php-0014: Fix your eyes on Christ. Paul looks back on his old life. Read Philippians 3:7 and Philippians 1:19.
c3-php-0015: Strength comes as we follow Christ. Paul shares how he runs his race. Read Philippians 3:13 and Philippians 1:25.
c2-heb-0013: Look to the Son’s throne. See what God has done for Him. Read Hebrews 1:9.
c2-heb-0014: Trust the Son’s greatness. These verses speak of creation and the world to come. Read Hebrews 1:12 and Hebrews 2:5.
c3-heb-0015: Christ draws near to His people. A later call invites us to consider Him. Read Hebrews 2:11 and Hebrews 3:1.
c3-heb-0016: Look to Jesus, our steady guide. A later verse speaks of what the Son suffered. Read Hebrews 3:2 and Hebrews 5:8.
c3-heb-0017: A royal priest stands tall here. Read Hebrews 7:4 and Hebrews 5:9.
c3-heb-0018: You are never forgotten. The writer speaks of the angels’ role. Read Hebrews 1:14 and Hebrews 2:12.
c3-heb-0019: Your hope is well placed. God’s people belong to Christ the Son. Read Hebrews 3:6 and Hebrews 1:8.
c3-heb-0020: A new kind of priest has come. Read Hebrews 7:13 and Hebrews 3:3.
c3-heb-0021: Rest in what Christ has done. The writer describes the old priesthood. Read Hebrews 10:11 and Hebrews 7:14.
c3-heb-0022: Jesus stands with His people. The writer brings another Scripture into view. Read Hebrews 2:13 and Hebrews 7:22.
c2-rom-0022: Mercy and justice meet in Christ. Paul tells why God acted as He did. Read Romans 3:25.
c2-2co-0009: Christ changes everything. Paul describes life after meeting Him. Read Second Corinthians 5:16 and Second Corinthians 5:14.
c3-gal-0011: Lean on God’s grace. Paul builds his case from Scripture. Read Galatians 3:11 and Galatians 3:12.
c3-heb-0023: Christ's promises are sure. The first covenant is spoken of as well. Read Hebrews 9:16 and Hebrews 9:18.
c3-1pe-0009: Jesus shows the way. Peter points us to His example. Read First Peter 2:22 and First Peter 2:21.
c3-rom-0023: Grace is God’s gift. Paul shows God’s righteousness at work. Read Romans 3:26 and Romans 3:21.
c3-2co-0010: Look up at God’s great love. Paul shows what He did through Christ. Read Second Corinthians 5:21 and Second Corinthians 5:15.
c3-1pe-0010: His love reaches you. Peter shows what Christ did in His suffering. Read First Peter 2:24 and First Peter 2:23.
c3-heb-0024: A promise waits for God’s people. The writer explains Christ’s work. Read Hebrews 9:15 and Hebrews 9:28.
c3-heb-0025: Christ brings sure hope. The writer speaks soberly about every life. Read Hebrews 9:27 and Hebrews 9:23.
